purpose: Traceable contract for automated shaft-hub-key models and DIN 6892/FVA calculations

compatibility.migration: schema 5 is migrated explicitly to schema 6 before defaults are merged
compatibility.alias_policy: retain synchronized compatibility aliases with provenance; reject conflicting values

distribution_policy.historical_release_guard: snapshot every protected 4.1 file before the build and verify path set, size and SHA-256 before and after 4.2 publication

minimum_evidence: identified source step and unloaded frame
external x_mm,z_mm,opening_um CSV with retained SHA-256
unchanged l_tr, t1tr and U_PF since postprocessing
A_FE_VOLUME.solver_boundary: The calculation engine never solves an ODB. The connected CAE backend can create or submit a Job only when explicitly enabled; both bundled release presets remain NOJOB, and no release evidence claims a solved source ODB

formulae: p_1_eq = K_V * K_lambda * K_R * F_eq / (l_tr * t1tr)  (equation 6)
M_teq = F_eq * d_w / 2, and M_teq = K_A * M_t_nom  (equation 7)
l_tr = l_PF - b for key form A, l_PF for form B, l_PF - b/2 for form AB  (equation 8)
t2tr = t2 - (r1 + s2) - g_c + 0.5 * (d_w - sqrt(d_w^2 - (b + 2*s2)^2))  (hub flank geometry)
K_Req = (M_teq - q_eq * M_tRmin) / M_teq with q_eq = 0.5  (equation 12)
M_t_zul_Nm = f_W * p_zul * d_w * l_tr * t_tr / (2 * K_V * K_lambda * K_R * 1000), with t_tr = t1tr on the shaft flank, t2tr on the hub flank and min(t1tr, t2tr) for the key
p_max_zul = f_L * p_zul, evaluated with phi = 0.9 for two keys
B_DIN_CURRENT.table2_policy: f_S and f_H come from DIN 6892 Table 2 per component and material class (key 1.1..1.4, shaft 1.3..1.7, hub 1.5, lamellar cast iron hub 2.0; f_H = 1.15 for case-hardened steel and undefined for lamellar cast iron). The standard requires the SMALLER tabulated f_S when the material is not known, so the lower bound is the default. f_S = null and f_H = null mean 'resolve from Table 2'; the GUI keeps those fields blank instead of writing a neutral 1.0, which would silently defeat the lookup
B_DIN_CURRENT.phi_policy: equation 10 defines phi only for i = 1 (phi = 1) and i = 2 (phi = 0.75 for p_zul, 0.9 for p_max); more keys require an explicit measured load share
B_DIN_CURRENT.chamfer_policy: equation 9 uses the chamfer the geometry actually has; chamfer_s1_mm = null resolves to the derived key chamfer because evaluating s1 = 0 overstates t1tr and every derived torque. chamfer_s2_mm does the same on the hub flank
B_DIN_CURRENT.component_policy: evaluated separately for the shaft keyway, the hub keyway and the key, each with its own yield strength, its own Table 2 factors AND its own bearing depth: t1tr on the shaft flank, t2tr on the hub flank and min(t1tr, t2tr) for the key, because the key flank carries the same pressure as the mating keyway flank. The weakest component governs M_t_zul_Nm and is reported as governing_component together with governing_bearing_depth_mm. Without t2tr the hub and key fall back to t1tr and that fallback is reported as din6892_hub_bearing_depth_missing, because DIN 6885 gives t2 < t1 and the fallback overstates the hub bearing area
B_DIN_CURRENT.bearing_depth_policy: equation 9 as transcribed ADDS the chord correction 0.5*(d_w - sqrt(d_w^2 - (b+2*s1)^2)) and therefore returns t1tr > t1 for standard geometry, while the convex shaft flank geometry and the standard's own wording ('the effective depth is reduced by s1 and r') require SUBTRACTING it. An independent closed-form flank height is computed next to the equation and both values, their difference and an agrees flag are reported. bearing_depth_policy selects which value the pressure checks use: EQUATION_9 (default, the transcribed standard is never silently overruled), GEOMETRIC or CONSERVATIVE (the smaller of the two). A disagreement is reported as din6892_bearing_depth_optimistic. The hub keyway sits in a concave bore where the same algebraic form with a plus sign IS geometrically correct, so no policy is applied there
B_DIN_CURRENT.load_reversal_policy: equation 3 is driven by N_W, the number of LOAD DIRECTION reversals (Lastrichtungswechsel), which is what f_W penalises: the key alternately bearing on both shaft keyway flanks. N_W is NOT the load cycle count. An explicit N_W wins; otherwise R < 0 gives N_W = load_cycles (one flank change per cycle), R >= 0 gives N_W = 0 and f_W = 1 because a purely pulsating torque keeps the key on one flank, and an unknown load direction falls back to N_W = load_cycles. Every derivation is reported as din6892_load_reversal_derived or din6892_load_reversal_unknown_direction
B_DIN_CURRENT.application_factor_policy: M_teq = K_A * M_t_nom builds the equivalent torque from the nominal drive torque; torque_applied_Nm keeps precedence when both are supplied. torque_peak_applied_Nm is checked against p_max_zul and yields S_Fmax next to S_Feq
B_DIN_CURRENT.k_lambda_domain_policy: K_lambda itself is never interpolated or invented, but the reading is gated against the diagram bounds: K_lambda in 1.0..2.0, Q_A = d_w/D in 0.3..0.9, l_tr/d_w in 0.5..2, and one of the three load-derivation diagrams (FRONT/MIDDLE/REAR) has to be declared. Readings outside those bounds cannot have come from the standard and are reported as din6892_k_lambda_outside_diagram, din6892_k_lambda_qa_outside_diagram or din6892_k_lambda_length_outside_diagram
B_DIN_CURRENT.factor_policy: a licensed factor left at the neutral value 1.0 with USER-INPUT provenance marks the result PROVISIONAL_FACTORS instead of CALCULATED; K_lambda is the only remaining diagram read
B_DIN_CURRENT.limitation: K_lambda is a licensed DIN 6892 diagram (range 1.0 .. 2.0 over Q_A = d/D from 0.3 to 0.9 and l_tr/d_w from 0.5 to 2, selected by the load derivation position) and has no closed form; the mapping from a_0/l_tr to one of the three diagrams is a declaration about the assembly and is not guessed

formulae: K_d = 2.08 * d_w^(-0.18) for d_w <= 100 mm, otherwise 0.82
M_t_zul_Nm = f_Sv * f_S_ges * f_H * f_W * Re * d_w * l_tr * t1tr / (2 * K_R * K_lambda * K_d * K_V * 1000)
B_FVA_2025.component_policy: the limit-load criterion is the relative plastic opening volume of the SHAFT keyway, so Re and Rm in equations 33 and 36 are the shaft's and f_WS takes the place of the shaft's tabulated f_S. Equation 33 never divides one part's tensile strength by another part's yield strength. The hub keyway was deliberately not measured by the project and hub cracking was out of scope, so hub and key are listed in components_not_covered and still need the current Method-B or Method-C pressure check
B_FVA_2025.friction_policy: K_R = 1 because FVA 600 III showed numerically and experimentally that a superposed interference fit does not raise the quasi-static transmissible torque; the DIN equation-12 value is still reported next to it, and the press fit remains beneficial for long-term fatigue strength
B_FVA_2025.validation: equation 26 is normalised at the research criterion v = 0.5, so f_Sv(1.0)/f_Sv(0.5) = 1.37 must reproduce the measured f_S(v=1)/f_S(v=0.5) of both material pairs (1.372 for C45+N and 1.385 for 42CrMoS4+QT); this is checked by the self-test
transcription_notes: equation 29 gives K_d = 0.9082 at d_w = 100 mm while the report's large-diameter value is a documented simplification of 0.82; the step is retained and reported as fva_size_factor_transcription_step instead of being interpolated
equations 15 and 34 were fitted for 0.5 <= l_tr/d_w <= 1.3 and K_d for roughly 10 to 450 mm; outside those ranges the result is reported as extrapolated
B_FVA_2025.material_policy: calibrated on the discrete FVA catalogue; evaluating it with other material data is allowed but reported as din6892_material_source_not_fva
B_FVA_2025.reference_results: the measured support factors and torques of variants VB1..VB8 are retained for comparison; reproducing the absolute torques additionally needs K_lambda from the licensed diagram, so only the dimensionless identities are self-checkable
B_FVA_2025.limitation: research reformulation from FVA 600 III booklet 1686 (2025), not a published DIN edition; hardened joints and the hardness factor f_H could not be validated by the project

formulae: M_t_zul_Nm = p_zul * (h - t1) * l_tr * (d_w / 2) * i * phi / 1000
l_tr_required = M_t_required * safety_factor / M_t_per_bearing_mm_Nm  (inverse of equation 31)
l_PF_required = l_tr_required + b for form A, + b/2 for form AB, l_tr_required for form B  (equation 8)
C_PRELIMINARY.component_policy: evaluated per component with p_zul = f_S * Re of that component; the weakest governs, which reduces to the scalar Re_min form when only that scalar is available
C_PRELIMINARY.engaged_height_policy: equation 31 works with the hub-side engagement height h - t1, not with the nominal DIN 6885 hub depth t2. The two differ by the radial top clearance g_c = t1 + t2 - h, so h - t1 = t2 - g_c is automatically the smaller and therefore the conservative value; both are reported so the clearance stays visible instead of looking like a transcription error. A negative g_c means the key is taller than the two keyway depths together and equation 31 does not describe the joint, reported as din6892_method_c_clearance_negative
C_PRELIMINARY.sizing_policy: Method C is a sizing method, so the inverse result is returned as well: the bearing length and the DIN 6885 nominal key length a required torque needs, with the safety factor applied to the requirement so M_t_design >= M_t_required. torque_required_Nm = null reuses torque_applied_Nm. A result above l_tr/d_w = 1.3 is reported as din6892_method_c_sizing_too_long because the rear part of the key then transmits practically no pressure
C_PRELIMINARY.consistency_policy: Method C must stay on the safe side of the more detailed Method B. cross_method_consistency reports M_t_C / M_t_B and raises din6892_method_c_not_conservative when Method C allows more torque, because a joint sized with Method C alone would then be unsafe

variants.DIN_PUBLISHED: p_zul = 0.9 * Re_min, the published DIN 6892 Method C (default)
variants.FVA_2025: p_zul,neu = f_S * Re_min with f_S = 1 (equation 32); FVA 600 III proposes dropping the 10 % reduction because the measured capacity is consistently higher

C_PRELIMINARY.limitation: preliminary sizing only; Method B/A and DIN 743 remain required where applicable. Equation 31 assumes one constant pressure over h - t1 and ignores both the load distribution K_lambda and the shaft flank height

common.effective_bearing_depth: DIN 6892 equation 9 as implemented in din6892_methods.effective_bearing_depth, reported together with the independent flank-height cross-check and the selected bearing_depth_policy
common.hub_bearing_depth: din6892_methods.hub_effective_bearing_depth derives t2tr from the concave hub bore geometry, bounded by the roof fillet r1, the chamfer s2 and the top clearance g_c
common.bearing_length: din6892_methods.bearing_length and nominal_key_length implement equation 8 and its inverse for DIN 6885 forms A, B and AB
common.companion_methods: the analytical methods B_DIN_CURRENT, B_FVA_2025 and C_PRELIMINARY are always evaluated next to the selected primary method on the same inputs and persisted under din6892.companions; a companion that cannot be evaluated reports its own reason and never invalidates the primary result. din6892.companions.consistency compares them and names the governing analytical torque
common.governing_component: every bearing check reports which of shaft/hub/key governs, plus the per-component table with each part's own bearing depth and any component that was not checked

fva_catalog.variant_policy: discrete research configurations; applying geometry is explicit and does not imply CAE executability
fva_catalog.material_policy: no interpolation between measured diameter points

legacy_backend.incompatible_requests: blocked with stable validation codes; never coerced

sources.implemented_scope: Derived dimensions for 6 < d1 <= 500 mm, standard lengths, r1/r2 ranges and forms A/B/AB
sources.copyright_policy: The source document and protected figures are not distributed

sources.implemented_scope: Methods A/B/C equation workflows and M_t,zul/M_t,design; unavailable licensed diagram factors remain explicit inputs
sources.limitation: A calculated result is not certification and requires engineering review

sources.implemented_scope: VB1-VB8, discrete material points, Method-A opening-volume criterion and proposed Method-B reformulation
sources.limitation: Research proposal, not a current DIN edition; the bundled one-cycle backend is regression only
separate from and not a replacement for DIN 6892 Method B

requirements.statement: Read and validate the raw schema before merging defaults; migrate 5 to 6 and reject future schemas
Keep canonical geometry keys and compatibility aliases synchronized with conflict detection and provenance
Reject normative DIN 6885 selection outside 6 < d1 <= 500 mm
Use one 26-band source for b, h, t1, t2, +tol(t1), d2_add and r1/r2 ranges
Keep key_nominal_length, slot_total_length and load_bearing_length distinct
Implement exact forms A, B and AB; block unavailable forms and DIN 6888 geometry
Evaluate Methods A, B-current, B-FVA and C through one pure Python 2.7/3 engine
Report M_t,zul and M_t,design with method, equations, inputs, source and evidence badge
Check the shaft keyway on t1tr, the hub keyway on t2tr and the key on min(t1tr, t2tr); report any fallback to the shaft depth as optimistic
Drive f_W from the number of load direction reversals N_W, derive it from the load ratio when absent and report the derivation
Cross-check equation 9 against the independent shaft flank height, keep the transcribed equation as default and expose a selectable depth policy
Gate the licensed K_lambda reading against the diagram bounds Q_A, l_tr/d_w and the declared load derivation position without interpolating it
Size the Method C bearing length and DIN 6885 key length from a required torque and warn when Method C is not conservative against Method B
Expose VB1-VB8 and both material pairs without interpolation or false CAE support
Label the one-cycle NOJOB workflow as LEGACY_PARTIAL regression, not complete Method A
Import finite non-negative rectangular CSV grids, integrate DeltaV, retain SHA-256 and require complete unloaded-frame evidence
Keep requested, derived and realized CAE records separate in JSON, GUI and report
Provide Spanish, English and German with exact key and placeholder parity
Apply hard mesh gates before deterministic ranking and aggregate by the worst piece
Publish only ModelBuilder_4.2 by whitelist and prove ModelBuilder_4.1 artifacts unchanged
